name: ai-light-studio
description: 代码工匠 · AI灯光设计SaaS —— 根目录快捷命令入口（npm run 查看全部）

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.prod: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix server run lint:fix && npm --prefix web run lint:fix
scripts.format: npm --prefix server run format && npm --prefix web run format
